name: Simple Countdown
author: Rick Harris
description: This plugin will give you a countdown to a specified date. This plugin is standalone and does not require any other plugins to run.

privacy.summary: Sends your countdown text and display settings to the FPP player address you enter (this device by default). Nothing goes online and nothing is kept about anyone.

sends.to: http://the FPP player address you enter (Host Location)
sends.what: the countdown message text and the overlay model, font and colour to show it with
sends.why: to display the countdown on that player's pixel overlay model

privacy.other: Each run of the 'Simple Countdown-Run' command writes the countdown text and its settings to the plugin log (logs/plugin-FPP-Simple-Countdown.log). Settings are kept after uninstall.
